codes.rationale: The attending lists prerenal AKI due to dehydration as the principal diagnosis. It was present on admission with Cr 2.1 against a baseline of 0.9, and it was the main focus of treatment.
codes.critic_reason: Provider-documented AKI (Cr 2.1 vs baseline 0.9, 2.3x), POA, treated with IVF, resolved by HD2; the discharge summary confirms it. issues.summary: Both the AKI and the norovirus gastroenteritis with dehydration were present on admission and treated with IV fluids. The attending designated AKI as principal, but sequencing norovirus gastroenteritis (A08.11) first would also be defensible.
The H&P records HCO3 19 and lists 'metabolic acidosis' only as a finding, with no provider diagnosis. Query the provider if clinically significant. No code assigned.

The HD3 and HD4 notes carry identical 'AKI - worsening, Cr trending up; nephrology consulted, renal US ordered' text, despite Cr 0.9 and no other nephrology or imaging documentation. Confirm with the provider that there was no recurrent AKI and no consult.
